title: Keeping White School Uniforms Bright All Term
excerpt: Collars, cuffs and red-earth stains — our tested tips for brighter whites.
body:
White uniforms take a beating. A little care each week keeps them looking new for longer.

## Pre-treat collars and cuffs

Rub a little Multipurpose Liquid Soap into collars and cuffs and leave for 10 minutes before washing.

## Soak overnight for red-earth stains

Soak in cool water with a capful of Multipurpose Liquid Soap. Hot water can set some stains.

- Wash whites separately
- Rinse well to avoid yellowing
- Dry in the sun, inside out
